newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israelis wound Palestinian protester - hospital. [CORRECTED 14:00 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Israelis wound Palestinian protester - hospital. [CORRECTED 14:00 GMT]

text.p: (Corrects headline and the text to show that the protester was critically wounded and not killed as initially stated.)
Israeli troops critically wounded a Palestinian during protests on Wednesday over Israel's policy on Jerusalem, hospital sources said.
They identified the protester as Yasser Abed al-Ghani, 23, of Tulkarm in the West Bank, who was critically wounded by a bullet during a protest in Ramallah north of Jerusalem.
